target_market_analysis.segmentation: Tier 1: Triple-crown accredited schools (80 in Europe). Tier 2: Double-accredited schools (120). Tier 3: Single-accredited (100).
target_market_analysis.icp_refined: Tier 1 triple-crown business school with 500+ MBA students, existing LMS, Dean of Programmes as champion, annual IT budget >500k EUR
target_market_analysis.market_size_tam_sam_som: TAM: 90M EUR. SAM: 24M EUR (80 Tier 1 schools). SOM Year 1: 480k EUR (8 schools at 60k)

competitors.name: Civitas Learning
competitors.positioning: US-focused student success platform for large universities
competitors.pricing: Enterprise pricing 100k-500k USD primarily US market

competitors.name: Brightspace Insights (D2L)
competitors.positioning: Analytics module within D2L LMS ecosystem
competitors.pricing: 5-15 EUR per student per year add-on
weaknesses: Generic not tailored to business schools

competitors.name: Internal LMS reporting
competitors.positioning: Built-in Canvas or Moodle analytics used by most schools today

competitive_advantages: Only platform purpose-built for European business school accreditation requirements
Cross-institution benchmarking creates network effects unavailable to single-school solutions
Predictive dropout intervention directly tied to school ranking metrics

marketing_mix.product: Cloud SaaS platform with LMS integration, predictive analytics, accreditation reporting, and benchmarking
marketing_mix.pricing_policy: Annual subscription: 60k EUR base for schools under 1000 students, 90k for 1000-3000, 120k for 3000+
marketing_mix.distribution: Direct sales via founder network. Conference presence at EFMD and AMBA events. LMS vendor co-marketing.
marketing_mix.promotion: Case study-led after first 3 pilots. Webinar series on accreditation compliance. Whitepaper via AMBA channels.

customer_relations.communication: Quarterly business reviews. Monthly usage reports. Dedicated Slack channel per institution.
customer_relations.loyalty_strategy: Multi-year contracts with 10% discount for 3-year commitment. Benchmarking data as retention hook.

cac_assumptions.cac_source: B2B SaaS benchmarks for enterprise education sales including conference attendance and site visits

market_entry_strategy: Land with 3 pilot schools from Alex's network at discounted pricing to generate case studies and retention data. Use pilot results to create AMBA-endorsed whitepaper. Scale to Tier 1 schools via conference-driven outbound and LMS vendor referrals.

assumptions_used.statement: 60k EUR price point viable for Tier 1 schools based on IT budget benchmarks
assumptions_used.source_detail: Comparable EdTech SaaS pricing in European higher education

assumptions_used.statement: 5-month sales cycle realistic for university procurement
assumptions_used.source_detail: Alex experienced 4-6 month cycles in prior role

assumptions_used.statement: 18k EUR CAC achievable with founder-led sales model
assumptions_used.source_detail: Lower than typical enterprise CAC due to existing network

uncertainties: Whether pilot discounting will set price expectations that hinder full-price sales
Conversion rate from conference leads to qualified pipeline
